And then there are also family problems in the game. De avond ervoor is hij op een vergadering geweest van een voetbalclub die door zijn besluit hun velden kwijtraken. Is een wraakactie van de supporters uit de hand gelopen? Of is er meer aan de hand en kloppen de geruchten dat de wethouder bevriende zakenrelaties voortrok bij gemeentezaken en is hij het slachtoffer geworden van een kwade concurrent? They redecorate them together. Today the bus is being challenged with an original design by Noa and that moves the whole family. Eddy has an appointment with his cardiologist. In recent weeks he did not feel well and he was struggling with heart rhythm disorders. He is worried ... / Een half jaar na zijn ongeluk stapt Junior weer achter het stuur van zijn rallywagen. Hij is een en al concentratie voor zijn eerste race: de rally van Kortrijk. Het supportersteam Planckaert is op post om hem aan te moedigen. Junior lijkt goed in de race te zitten, maar dan loopt het mis ... Enkele maanden geleden kocht Francesco met zijn gezin een oude bus. Die knappen ze samen op. Vandaag wordt de bus gewrapt met een origineel ontwerp van Noa en dat ontroert het hele gezin. Eddy heeft een afspraak met zijn cardioloog. De afgelopen weken voelde hij zich niet goed en kampte hij met hartritmestoornissen. Hij maakt zich zorgen ...

programme.title: Same door, 20 years later / Zelfde deur, 20 jaar later
programme.desc: At Rik from Bree, the first artificial heart valve was planted in Belgium. Martin could hear them ticking. Rik lived heavily afterwards and the wild life took his toll. But Rik and Ria would immediately start again. Don't regret anything, don't leave anything. Just like Marc, who used to design gardens, but now leads an artist's life. Or Dorine, who is happy because everything stayed as it was in the silent polders of Eggenaartkapelle. It is the last time that Martin surprised old acquaintances. / Bij Rik uit Bree werd de eerste kunsthartklep in België ingeplant. Martin kon ze horen tikken. Rik leefde er nadien zwaar op los en het wilde leven eiste zijn tol. Maar Rik en Ria zouden toch onmiddellijk herbeginnen. Nergens spijt van, niks laten liggen. Net als Marc, die vroeger tuinen ontwierp, maar nu een artiestenleven leidt. Of Dorine, die gelukkig is omdat alles bleef zoals het was in de stille polders van Eggewaartskapelle. Het is de laatste keer dat Martin oude bekenden verrast.

programme.desc: The Person series is a Turkish criminal drama from 2018. in the director of the Sayplace, which in magnificent way connects the true tragedy and absurdity of life, and the test of existence puts moral values. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? programme.title: Then and now / Tada And Sada
programme.desc: The series includes the late 1940s, the end of the Second World War, the beginning of the wars in Yugoslavia .. From the time of the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (SFRY) in the 1980s, the rise of the Yugoslavia, to the conflict that lasted more than a decade. The series is now compared and then through various topics, including living standards, political system, human rights, religious rights, national recognition, media freedom, freedom of citizens. They face both sides, the one who continues to say that in the past was better for us, and the one that supports the present as better. The series opens a debate on whether the advocates for "then" is too romantically blinded by the past and too pessimistic about the current situation, and vice versa, whether they are for "now" too harsh by the past and the then system. / Serija obuhvata ​​period kasnih 1940-ih, kraj Drugog svjetskog rata do početka devedesetih, početak ratova u Jugoslaviji.. od vremena Socijalistička Federativne Republike Jugoslavije (SFRJ), preko ekonomske i političke krize 1980-ih godina, porasta nacionalizma, raspada Jugoslavije, pa do konflikta koji je trajao više od jedne decenije. Serija upoređuje Sada i Tada kroz različite teme, uključujući životni standard, politički sistem, ljudska prava, vjerska prava, nacionalno priznanje, slobodu medija, slobodu građana. Suočavaju se obje strane, ona koja nastavlja da govori da nam je u prošlosti bilo bolje, i ona koja podržava sadašnjost kao bolje. Serija otvara debatu o tome da li su zagovornici za "Tada" previše romantično zaslijepljeni prošlošću i previše pesimistični o sadašnjoj situaciji, i obrnuto, da li su oni za "Sada" suviše oštri prema prošlosti i tadašnjem sistemu.

programme.title: Pope, the most powerful man in history / Papa, najmoćniji čovjek u historiji
programme.desc: The six -part documentary series explores the history of the cult, globally significant role of the Pope, one of the most respected and most beloved figures. Despite the constantly changing world, Catholics viewed the pope as a lighthouse of faith, morality and divine leadership. The story of a apostle on the started trip, culminating in a global figure over a community with more than 1.2 billion followers. Each of the six episodes examines a key historical moment, in the changing dynamics of this extremely strong role, and explores that the Pope and the Church have occupied the position they have today. One world leader, with military, political and religious power, still remains wrapped in a veil of secrets, despite the unimaginable influence through history and the use of his power to design the flow of world history. Thanks to the approach to Vatican archives and exclusive interviews with some of the most prominent religious leaders and theologians, the series explores that the 12 apostles grew into today's 1.2 billion Catholics. In order to make it clearer that one man and one institution can vow to such heights, we return for two thousand years back, until the incredible beginnings of Christianity. Starting with Peter's movement full of danger, which emerged from the bottom of the social ladder, about the dramatic journey of the Church through time, all the way to the Crusades, to which it embarked on to overcome the Holy Land to the rule of Islam. / Šestodijelni dokumentarni serijal istražuje historiju kultne, globalno značajne uloge pape, jednog od najcjenjenijih i najomiljenijih figura. Uprkos svijetu koji se stalno mijenja, katolici su na papu gledali kao na svjetionik vjere, morala i božansko vodstvo. Priča o jednom apostolu na započetom putovanju, koje je kulminiralo globalnom figurom nad zajednicom s više od 1,2 milijardu sljedbenika. Svaka od šest epizoda ispituje ključni historijski trenutak, u promjenjivoj dinamici ove iznimno snažne uloge, i istražuje kako su papa i crkva zauzeli položaj koji danas imaju. Jedan svjetski vođa, s vojnom, političkom i vjerskom moći, i dalje ostaje obavijen velom tajne, uprkos nezamislivom utjecaju kroz historiju i korištenju svoje moći da bi oblikovao tok svjetske historije. Zahvaljujući pristupu vatikanskim arhivima i ekskluzivnim intervjuima s nekima od najistaknutijih vjerskih vođa i teologa, serija istražuje kako je 12 apostola preraslo u današnjih 1,2 milijarde katolika. Da bi bilo jasnije kako se jedan čovjek i jedna institucija mogu vinuti u takve visine, vraćamo se dvije hiljade godina unazad, sve do nevjerojatnih početaka kršćanstva. Počevši s Petrovim pokretom punim opasnosti, koji je izniknuo s dna društvene ljestvice, o dramatičnom putovanju Crkve kroz vrijeme, pa sve do križarskih ratova u koje je krenula kako bi preotela Svetu Zemlju vladavini islama.

Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. programme.desc: Fifteen -year -old Eli Shane is in life all usually, except one thing. Comes from the Shane family. Each member of that family traveled to the Underground of Slugterre to protect the special world of Slugs. Now it is a turn on the Elijah, to visit the underground and to protect it from the enemy, whether he is ready or not. Eli is persistent in the intention of becoming a hero, in order to manage to resist the forces of evil. Together with trixie friends, cords and print, he must carefully collect and train small animals, different snails, who have the ability to transform into magical monsters. / Petnaestogodišnjem Eliju Shaneu je u životu sve obično, osim jedne stvari. Dolazi iz porodice Shane. Svaki član te porodice putovao je u podzemlje Slugterre, kako bi zaštitio posebni svijet slug-ova. Sada je red na Elija, da posjeti podzemlje i da ga zaštiti od neprijatelja, bio on spreman ili ne. Eli je ustrajan u namjeri da postane heroj, kako bi se uspio oduprijeti silama zla. Zajedno sa prijateljima Trixie, Kordom i Prontom mora pažljivo sakupljati i trenirati male životinje, različite puževe, koji imaju sposobnost transformirati se u magična čudovišta.

programme.title: Then and now / Tada And Sada
programme.desc: The series includes the late 1940s, the end of the Second World War, the beginning of the wars in Yugoslavia .. From the time of the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (SFRY) in the 1980s, the rise of the Yugoslavia, to the conflict that lasted more than a decade. The series is now compared and then through various topics, including living standards, political system, human rights, religious rights, national recognition, media freedom, freedom of citizens. They face both sides, the one who continues to say that in the past was better for us, and the one that supports the present as better. The series opens a debate on whether the advocates for "then" is too romantically blinded by the past and too pessimistic about the current situation, and vice versa, whether they are for "now" too harsh by the past and the then system. / Serija obuhvata ​​period kasnih 1940-ih, kraj Drugog svjetskog rata do početka devedesetih, početak ratova u Jugoslaviji.. od vremena Socijalistička Federativne Republike Jugoslavije (SFRJ), preko ekonomske i političke krize 1980-ih godina, porasta nacionalizma, raspada Jugoslavije, pa do konflikta koji je trajao više od jedne decenije. Serija upoređuje Sada i Tada kroz različite teme, uključujući životni standard, politički sistem, ljudska prava, vjerska prava, nacionalno priznanje, slobodu medija, slobodu građana. Suočavaju se obje strane, ona koja nastavlja da govori da nam je u prošlosti bilo bolje, i ona koja podržava sadašnjost kao bolje. Serija otvara debatu o tome da li su zagovornici za "Tada" previše romantično zaslijepljeni prošlošću i previše pesimistični o sadašnjoj situaciji, i obrnuto, da li su oni za "Sada" suviše oštri prema prošlosti i tadašnjem sistemu.

programme.title: Pope, the most powerful man in history / Papa, najmoćniji čovjek u historiji
programme.desc: The six -part documentary series exploring the history of the cult, globally significant role of the Pope, one of the most respected and most beloved figures. Despite the constantly changing world, Catholics viewed the pope as a lighthouse of faith, morality and divine leadership. The story of a apostle on the started trip, culminating in a global figure over a community with more than 1.2 billion followers. Each of the six episodes examines a key historical moment, in the changing dynamics of this extremely strong role and explores that the Pope and the Church have occupied the position they have today. One world leader .. with military, political and religious power remains wrapped in a veil of secrets, despite the unimaginable influence through the history and use of his power to design the flow of world history. Thanks to the approach to Vatican archives and exclusive interviews with some of the most prominent religious leaders and theologians, the series explores that the 12 apostles grew into today's 1.2 billion Catholics. / Šestodijelni dokumentarni serijal koji istražuje historiju kultne, globalno značajne uloge pape, jednog od najcjenjenijih i najomiljenijih figura. Uprkos svijetu koji se stalno mijenja, katolici su na papu gledali kao na svjetionika vjere, morala i božansko vodstvo. Priča o jednom apostolu na započetom putovanju, koje je kulminiralo globalnom figurom nad zajednicom s više od 1,2 milijardu sljedbenika. Svaka od šest epizoda ispituje ključni historijski trenutak, u promjenjivoj dinamici ove iznimno snažne uloge i istražuje kako su papa i crkva zauzeli položaj koji danas imaju. Jedan svjetski vođa.. s vojnom, političkom i vjerskom moći ostaje obavijen velom tajne, uprkos nezamislivom utjecaju kroz historiju i korištenju svoje moći da bi oblikovao tok svjetske historije. Zahvaljujući pristupu vatikanskim arhivima i ekskluzivnim intervjuima s nekima od najistaknutijih vjerskih vođa i teologa, serija istražuje kako je 12 apostola preraslo u današnjih 1,2 milijarde katolika.

programme.title: The game of fate / Igra sudbine
programme.desc: The Sultan wants to find out the story of Alis, daughter Madam Anet, and find out if they really have so many similarities. However, Feride will surprise everything at the company with her catalog, named Fenix. Because he rejoices him again, Tahsin leaves Kerem the villa where his family lives, but begs him not to say anything Perihan. Aziz is confused when he sees Ferida with Jalcina, but also when he realized that the watch that fell out of Feride was actually belonging to his grandfather ... roles: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim özelu, Devrim özkan, ümit Kintarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran. / Sultan želi saznati priču o Alis, kćerki madam Anet, i otkriti da li zaista imaju toliko sličnosti. Aziz je zabrinut, jer se približavaju rokovi kada moraju klijentima dostaviti katalog kreacija i nije siguran da li je Feride dorasla tom zadatku. Međutim, Feride će sve u firmi iznenaditi svojim katalogom kojem je dala ime Feniks. Zbog toga što ga ponovo ucjenjuje, Tahsin prepušta Keremu vilu u kojoj živi njegova porodica, ali ga moli da ništa ne govori Perihan. Aziz je zbunjen kada vidi Feride sa Jalčinom, ali i kada shvati da je sat koji je ispao Feride, zapravo pripadao njegovom djedu...Uloge: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet OzgurRežija: Murat Onbul

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

Duel of the earth / Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: DULUM Earth - (S03, E04, Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) Dominik and Milan Zeko moved from Germany to Lika to establish their own farm and dairy. The episode follows their transition from the life of the IT expert in Frankfurt in livestock in Lika, where they grow cows Jersey and produce milk and cheeses in their family dairy. The episode deals with the challenges they face, such as high energy and predator costs, but also the success they have achieved with products such as fruit yogurt and traditional cheeses. Viewers will find out how they have expanded their business to the whole of Croatia and maintained high environmental standards. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Dulum zemlje - (S03, E04, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Dominik i Milana Zeko preselili su se iz Njemačke u Liku kako bi osnovali vlastitu farmu i mljekaru. Epizoda prati njihov prelazak iz života IT stručnjaka u Frankfurtu u stočare u Lici, gdje uzgajaju krave jersey i proizvode mlijeko i sireve u svojoj obiteljskoj mljekari. Epizoda se bavi izazovima s kojima se susreću, poput visokih troškova energije i predatora, ali i uspjehom koji su postigli s proizvodima poput voćnih jogurta i tradicionalnih sireva. Gledatelji će saznati kako su proširili svoje poslovanje na cijelu Hrvatsku i zadržali visoke ekološke standarde. R.: Filip Filković...

programme.title: Siniša Leopold - Mr. Tamburica / Siniša Leopold - gospodin Tamburica
programme.desc: Siniša Leopold - Mr. Tamburica - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2022) as a chief Dirigent was led by the Tamburitza Orchestra of HRT for 37 years, longer than Herbert von Karajan orchestra of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra! He is also a lecturer in the tambourine course at the Academy of Music in Zagreb, and for 13 years he was also the artistic director of the Kajkavian Popevki Festival in Krapina. As an author and musician, he is present at about a hundred sound carriers, he has received many awards (one arena, several Porin) and awards and honored with Danica Croatia with the image of Marko Marulić. He is the author of the book "Tamburitza in Croats" and one of the co -authors of our first tamburitza textbook. With all this, the author is more than 650 music works, and he will probably be best remembered for the hit "My Gigs", who has almost become a folk song in the meantime. He is ... Mr. Tamburitza! R.: Ivan Mokrovic ... / Siniša Leopold - gospodin Tamburica - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2022) Kao šef-dirigent vodio je Tamburaški orkestar HRT-a 37 godina, dulje nego Herbert von Karajan orkestar Berlinske filharmonije! Jednako toliko i predavač je kolegija Tambura na Muzičkoj akademiji u Zagrebu, a 13 godina bio je i umjetnički ravnatelj Festivala kajkavskih popevki u Krapini. Kao autor i glazbenik prisutan je na stotinjak nosača zvuka, dobitnik je mnogih nagrada (jedne Arene, nekoliko Porina) i priznanja te odlikovan Redom Danice hrvatske s likom Marka Marulića. Autor je knjige "Tambura u Hrvata" te jedan od suautora prvog našeg udžbenika za tamburaše. Uza sve to autor je više od 650 glazbenih djela, a vjerojatno će najbolje ostati zapamćen po hitu "Svirci moji" koji je u međuvremenu već gotovo postao narodnom pjesmom. On je... gospodin Tamburica! R.: Ivan Mokrović...

programme.desc: Gardener - (S05, E12, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) The new season of gardeners brings a number of inspirational solutions for different situations and problems related to organic growing vegetables and fruits. There are many challenges, especially those related to climate change. In unpredictable intervals alternate floods, hail and dry periods, which directly affects the established rhythm of the gardening season. It's time for change, but also for accepting responsibility for nature that needs our help. We will find out how to influence biodiversity in our own garden, how to preserve autochthonous types of plants from the surrounding area, but also get to know some exotic types of vegetables and fruits. But with an abundance of gardening tips, the gardener also takes us on our way. We will get to know the beautiful contemporary gardens and biological lakes and learn how to relax after working in the garden with the beauty of nature. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S05, E12, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Nova sezona Vrtlarice donosi niz inspirativnih rješenja za različite situacije i probleme vezane uz organski uzgoj povrća I voća. Vrijeme je za promjene, ali i za prihvaćanje odgovornosti za prirodu koja treba našu pomoć. Doznat ćemo kako utjecati na bioraznolikost u vlastitom vrtu, kako sačuvati autohtone vrste biljaka iz okolice, ali i upoznati neke egzotične vrste povrća i voća. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E09, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promeda owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E09, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: The Huaorani tribe: a touch with the modern world / Pleme Huaorani: Dodir sa suvremenim svijetom
programme.desc: Waorani à Lorea Dun Nouveau Monde - (Doc. Film, France, 2023), on the verge of a wild Amazonia, a group of adventurers descend with the dingers of the Tiputini River to visit the South American Indians community of Huaorani. It is the last indigenous people in the country that has been discovered, and are now connected to the modern world. Therefore, an indelible social gap is created, which only affects the heart of the family core. Young generations go to cities, and the elderly want to keep the ancient lifestyle of their ancestors, which is at the center of the forest. Deculturalization is fast and cruel and in this process clearly the role is clearly evident for most of the Indian peoples of Amazon. They are faced with the question of how to keep their culture and tradition in the modern world, where the use of oil resources reduces their territory. R .: Philippe Mistral ... / Waorani à loree dun nouveau monde - (dok. film, Francuska, 2023) Na rubu divlje Amazonije skupina pustolova spušta se gumenjacima rijekom Tiputini kako bi posjetila zajednicu južnoameričkih Indijanaca Huaorani. To je posljednji autohtoni narod u državi koji je otkriven, a sad su povezani sa suvremenim svijetom. Zbog toga se stvara neizbrisiv društveni jaz koji zahvaća samo srce obiteljske jezgre. Mladi naraštaji odlaze u gradove, a stariji žele zadržati drevni način života svojih predaka, kojem je u središtu šuma. Dekulturalizacija je brza i okrutna i u tom se procesu jasno očitavaju ulozi za većinu indijanskih naroda Amazonije. Suočeni su s pitanjem kako zadržati svoju kulturu i tradicije u suvremenom svijetu, gdje iskorištavanje naftnih resursa smanjuje njihov teritorij. R.: Philippe Mistral...

programme.title: Stani na otoku / Stani na otoku
programme.desc: Stand on the island - (E08, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2022) a long time ago when the islands were the tops of the mountains, and the storms were much more powerful than today, the north winds left the sand of the river by. They say, that's how Susak came about. Without asphalt and cars, just miles of sandy trails and a reed that protects against erosion. In the former state, Susak was the most densely populated area. After the Second World War, the Susak people emigrated to New Jersey and create a community there, which has 4000 today, while 100 are left in Susak, including Aunt Lenci, who has drawn into the heart of the author. R.: Andrea Buca ... / Stani na otoku - (E08, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2022) Nekad davno kad su otoci bili vrhovi planina, a oluje mnogo snažnije nego danas, sjeverni vjetrovi dopuhali su pijesak rijeke Po. Kažu, tako je nastao je Susak. Bez asfalta i automobila, samo kilometri pješčanih staza i trska koja štiti od erozije. U bivšoj državi Susak je bio najgušće naseljen prostor. Nakon Drugog svjetskog rata Suščani iseljavaju u New Jersey i ondje stvaraju zajednicu koja danas broji 4000, dok ih je na Susku ostalo 100, među njima i teta Lenći koja se uvukla u srce autorice. R.: Andrea Buča...

programme.title: Research league / Forska liga
programme.desc: Forma League - (E04, Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) Everyone is ready for a new life cycle. Preparations for the tourist season are in full swing - jobs are advertised, workers are looking for, ships are clean, apartments are decorated to welcome the first guests, and the football season is coming to an end. We see them changing jerseys for skipper uniforms, waiters, construction workers and numerous other roles that keep the island live during the season. As the league ends, this is how life on the island accelerates, preparing for the summer. The last games bring tension, excitement and final results. The celebration of the champion is the central event, and the comments of participants, champions and fans paint the passion that the league brings to the lives of the islanders. Creative producer: Sandra Basso Koscenarist: Kresimir Zelic R .: Haris Kozaric ... / Forska liga - (E04, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Svi su spremni za novi životni ciklus. Vidimo ih kako mijenjaju dresove za uniforme skipera, konobara, građevinskih radnika i brojnih drugih uloga koje održavaju otok živim tijekom sezone. Kako liga završava, tako se život na otoku ubrzava, pripremajući se za ljeto. Zadnje utakmice donose napetost, uzbuđenje i konačne rezultate. Proslava prvaka središnji je događaj, a komentari sudionika, prvaka i navijača oslikavaju strast koju liga unosi u živote otočana. programme.desc: MATERNAL - (E01, feature series, England, 2023) A series on a humorous, warm and original way shows the problems that employed mothers face. Through a series of funny and moving situations, we gradually find out more about the lives of three doctors who return to work after maternity leave and pandemic. Maryam, Catherine and Helen thought I could have everything - both children and successful careers in healthcare. But no one told them that after the birth of a child, nothing was the same as before. The mind, body, career and relationships change in unimaginable ways, and everyone expects women to simply accept it. For these three friends, who seek to reconcile numerous business and private obligations, life is a daily struggle, but at least they have each other. Dedicated to all women, mothers and health workers all over the world, the series offers a unique insight into the lives of people who maintain our overloaded health systems alive and unbreakable connections that bind them. R .: James Griffiths Ul.: Parinnder Note (Dr. Maryam Afidi), Lara Pulver (MS Catherine Macdiarmid), Lisa McGillis (Dr. Helen Cavendish), Dean Ridge (Dr. Simon Segman), Tina Louise Owens (receptationist) ... / Maternal - (E01, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Serija na duhovit, topao i originalan način prikazuje probleme s kojima se suočavaju zaposlene majke. programme.title: The famous sights / Slavne znamenitosti
programme.desc: Iconic Landmarks - (E05, Educational Program, France, 2018) at the foot of Champs -Élysee is one of the most luxurious hotels in the world - Hotel Crillon. For the achievement of this goal, the work of the restoration of epic proportions - the budget of 500 million euros, 4000 workers, including 150 craftsmen, who have constantly worked on the renovation of historical paintings, joinery and tapestry, some of which have been classified as historical monuments. From the ceilings covered with feathers to a sofa exclusively designed by Karl Lagerfeld, discover that the Crillon Hotel, under the artistic guidance of Alina Asmar Damman, experienced rebirth. Between excitement and anxiety, this documentary will allow you to view one of the most beautiful luxury hotels in the world. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E09, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promeda owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E10, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family can not be calmer - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E10, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: The famous sights / Slavne znamenitosti
programme.desc: Iconic Landmarks - (E06, Educational Program, France) with its huge 175 meters long hall, Orsay is home to the largest collection of impressionistic art in the world. This stone and steel building opened on December 1, 1986, officially opened by François Mitterrand, has been carrying the title of historic monument since 1978. Repeatedly destined for demolition, the Orsay Station building was the subject of many discussions before it was finally turned into a museum, a link that was missing between Louvre and the Pumpidou Center. From that moment on, this building constantly feeds the imagination of architects. Going through the project for the project, the Orsay Museum gradually grew and increased its splendor to attract more and more visitors. Discover what challenges have been encountered by architects and workers with all new changes in order to modernize the building with the preservation of its historical features. R.: Blandine Josselin ... / Iconic landmarks - (E06, obrazovni program, Francuska) Sa svojom golemom dvoranom dugom 175 metara, Orsay je dom najveće zbirke impresionističke umjetnosti na svijetu. Ta zgrada od kamena i čelika koju je 1. prosinca 1986. svečano otvorio François Mitterrand, od 1978. godine nosi titulu povijesnog spomenika. Više puta predodređena za rušenje, zgrada kolodvora Orsay bila je predmetom mnogih rasprava prije nego što je napokon pretvorena u muzej, kariku koja je nedostajala između Louvrea i Centra Pompidou. Od tog trenutka ova građevina neprestano hrani maštu arhitekata. Prolazeći kroz projekt za projektom, Muzej Orsay je postupno rastao i povećavao svoj sjaj kako bi privukao sve više posjetitelja. Otkrijte na kakve su sve izazove nailazili arhitekti i radnici pri svim novim izmjenama kako bi se građevina modernizirala uz očuvanje njezinih povijesnih obilježja. R.: Blandine Josselin...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E10, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family can not be calmer - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E10, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Doctor / Doktorice
programme.desc: MATERNAL - (E02, feature series, England, 2023) A series on a humorous, warm and original way shows the problems that employed mothers face. Through a series of funny and moving situations, we gradually find out more about the lives of three doctors who return to work after maternity leave and pandemic. Maryam, Catherine and Helen thought I could have everything - both children and successful careers in healthcare. But no one told them that after the birth of a child, nothing was the same as before. The mind, body, career and relationships change in unimaginable ways, and everyone expects women to simply accept it. For these three friends, who seek to reconcile numerous business and private obligations, life is a daily struggle, but at least they have each other. Dedicated to all women, mothers and health workers all over the world, the series offers a unique insight into the lives of people who maintain our overloaded health systems alive and unbreakable connections that bind them. R .: James Griffiths Ul.: Parmander Note (Dr. Maryam Afidi), Lara Pulver (MS Catherine Macdiarmid), Lisa McGillis (Dr. Helen Cavendish), Naomi Yang (Mae Zhang), Carolin Stoltz (Brigitta) ... / Maternal - (E02, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Serija na duhovit, topao i originalan način prikazuje probleme s kojima se suočavaju zaposlene majke. Kroz niz smiješnih i dirljivih situacija postupno doznajemo više o životima triju liječnica koje se nakon rodiljnog dopusta i pandemije vraćaju na posao. Maryam, Catherine i Helen mislile su da mogu imati sve - i djecu i uspješne karijere u zdravstvu. No nitko im nije rekao da nakon rođenja djeteta više ništa nije isto kao prije. Um, tijelo, karijera i odnosi mijenjaju se na nezamislive načine, a svi očekuju da žene jednostavno to prihvate. Za ove tri prijateljice, koje nastoje uskladiti brojne poslovne i privatne obveze, život je svakodnevna borba, no barem imaju jedna drugu. Posvećena svim ženama, majkama i zdravstvenim radnicama u cijelome svijetu, serija nudi jedinstveni uvid u živote ljudi koji održavaju naše preopterećene zdravstvene sustave na životu i neraskidive spone koje ih vežu. programme.title: Finger in the eye / Prst u oko
programme.desc: Finger in the eye - (E05, Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) The documentary series updates the topic of visual pollution and how much it affects the quality of life in Croatian cities. Through six episodes, we are led by the presenter Daniel Bilic, who in conversation with professionals from different areas who deal with public space - architects, urbanists, advertisers, designers, psychologists, sociologists, philosophers, art historians and graffiti - try to point out the phenomenon of visual pollution. Excessive advertising, illegal graffitiing, excessive signaling, amateur advertising on the streets and institutions, are just some topics that will be addressed. It is a series about the processes of normalizing public space loss and endangering public interest and health, which raises the question of why and how our society has left and polluted its public space, while free, visually unprecedented spaces have become an anomalies that seek to cancel and occupy it as soon as possible. How visual pollution has changed the face of cities and influenced the loss of identity in the fight for our attention? R .: Tiha Gudac ... / Prst u oko - (E05, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Dokumentarna serija aktualizira temu vizualnog zagađenja te koliko ono utječe na kvalitetu života u hrvatskim gradovima. Kroz šest epizoda vodi nas voditelj Daniel Bilić koji će u razgovoru s profesionalcima iz različitih područja koji se bave javnim prostorom - arhitektima, urbanistima, oglašivačima, dizajnerima, psiholozima, sociolozima, filozofima, povjesničarima umjetnosti i grafiterima - pokušati ukazati na fenomen vizualnog zagađenja. Pretjerano oglašavanje, ilegalno grafitiranje, pretjerana signalizacija, amatersko oglašavanje na ulicama i institucijama, samo su neke teme koje će se obraditi. To je serija o procesima normalizacije gubitka javnog prostora i ugrožavanja javnog interesa i zdravlja, koji postavlja pitanje zašto je i kako naše društvo prepustilo i onečistilo svoj javni prostor, dok su slobodni, vizualno nezagađeni prostori postali anomalija koja se nastoji što prije poništiti i okupirati. Koliko je vizualno zagađenje promijenilo lice gradova i utjecalo na gubitak identiteta u borbi za našu pažnju? R.: Tiha Gudac...

No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. programme.title: United 93 / United 93
programme.desc: United 93 - (Drama, USA, 2006) Tuesday, September 11, 2001. At the Newark airport, the usual, perfectly controlled crowd. All planes take off on time and everything is calm in the sky. At 6 o'clock and 43 minutes a United 93 aircraft took off for San Francisco. We follow the entrance of the passengers, who presented the careful shit of one of them, and the packaging of the separated parts of the explosive device. There are also four of the ordinary passengers in the Aerotal waiting room, which we recognize as those who have prepared for the abduction. Only a few hours later the flight controller in the headphones heard a vague voice saying, "The planes are abducted." At first, no one knows anything, and the extraordinary news on CNN for about 10 o'clock they seem unreal like a scientific fiction film. Smoke of shock, all employees in flight control are silent that one of the Twin Tower suddenly has a huge hole from which smoke erupts, and find out that a "smaller plane" has been stabbed in the building. And while the cameras are still resting on the Twins, another plane appears and scores into another tower. After the first shock, it became clear that it was a suicide mission, and panic and fear increased when two more planes were heard over the flight control, one of them is United 93 ... Pratimo ulazak putnika, kojemu je prehodilo pomno izbrijavanje jednoga od njih, te pakiranje razdvojenih dijelova eksplozivne naprave. U aerodomskoj čekaonici među običnim putnicima sjede i četvorica koje prepoznajemo kao one koji su se pripremili za otmicu. Nijemi od šoka, svi zaposleni u kontroli leta šutke gledaju kako jedan od Twin Towera odjednom ima golemu rupu iz koje izbija dim, te doznaju da se u zgradu zabio "manji avion". I dok kamere i dalje počivaju na Twinsima, pojavljuje se još jedan avion i zabija se u drugi toranj. Nakon prvog šoka, postalo je jasno da se radi o samoubilačkoj misiji, a panika i strah porasli su kad se preko kontrole leta čuje da su oteta još dva aviona, jedan od njih je i United 93... Obitelj Simpson čine: otac Homer, koji radi kao inspektor zaštite na radu u mjesnoj nuklearnoj elektrani, majka Marge, koja pokušava zadržati mir u obitelji, nestašni desetogodišnjak Bart, inteligentna saksofonistica osmogodišnja Lisa i najmanja Maggie, koja emocije izražava dudanjem. programme.title: Graffiti / Grafiti
programme.desc: Graffiti - (E04, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2025) In the fourth episode, we explore in which all the ways of drawing on the street walls can be earned. Due to visual attractiveness and ubiquity in cities, graffiti has quickly become interesting to advertisers from marginal subculture. Darko Bosnar, a marketing expert with many years of experience, reveals that he used to draw graffiti himself, and today he uses them in marketing campaigns. Fine artist Lunar reveals to us that he started making money as a graffiti in the early 1990s, drawing commercials around the neighborhood. As time went on and he became more and more famous, the volume of work grew. Not all Solo players are, so the 2010s created the collective "Gradele Gradele", which, in addition to the festival, also organizes commercial drafting projects for various clients and marketing agencies. The founder Marko Boko reveals to us that through a network of acquaintances with graffiti, street artists and muralists are present in all major cities in Croatia, and actually perform the function of the graffiti of the agency. In Berlin, the head of the Urban Art Museum, Urban Nation explains that the construction concern is funded by young artists and their projects. In Tokyo, Marina Mesar explains to us that she was able to come from drawing in Zagreb's streets to exhibitions around galleries around the world. Elena Calderon Alez presents us with her company that deals with the digitization of graffiti and street art in Tokyo and connects street artists from all over the world with their Japanese colleagues. The murals are also lucrative for major corporations. Soh Wadamoto, Terrada Warehouse project leader, brings together several dozen corporations that make the murals want to make an island tennoz tempting to investors and residents. Specifically, Tennoz, a former swampy island, turned into something rare in Japan, a brand new housing zone. Through all these trips, conversations, workshops and research, we are led by the presenter Luka Tokić, who, like most of us, is just a citizen who wants to find out why someone would like to ... / Grafiti - (E04, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2025) U četvrtoj epizodi istražujemo na koje se sve načine od crtanja po zidovima ulica može zarađivati. Zbog vizualne atraktivnosti i sveprisutnosti po gradovima grafiti su od marginalne supkulture vrlo brzo postali zanimljivi oglašivačima. Darko Bosnar, marketinški stručnjak s višegodišnjim iskustvom, otkriva kako je i sam nekada crtao grafite, a danas ih koristi u marketinškim kampanjama. Likovni umjetnik Lunar otkriva nam kako je već ranih devedesetih počeo zarađivati kao grafiter crtajući reklame po kvartu. Kako je vrijeme teklo i on postajao sve poznatiji, rastao je i obujam posla. Nisu svi solo igrači, tako da se 2010-ih stvorio kolektiv "Grafiti na gradele" koji osim festivala organizira i komercijalne projekte crtanja murala za razne klijente i marketinške agencije. Osnivač Marko Boko otkriva nam da su kroz mrežu poznanstava s grafiterima, street artistima i muralistima prisutni u svim većim gradovima u Hrvatskoj te zapravo obavljaju funkciju svojevrsne grafiti agencije. U Berlinu, voditelj muzeja urbane umjetnosti Urban Nation objašnjava kako građevinski koncern financira mlade likovne umjetnike i njihove projekte. U Tokyju nam Marina Mesar OKO objašnjava kako je ona uspjela doći od crtanja po zagrebačkim ulicama do izložbi po galerijama po cijelom svijetu. Elena Calderon Alez predstavlja nam svoju tvrtku koja se u Tokyju bavi digitalizacijom grafita i street arta te spaja ulične umjetnike iz cijelog svijeta s njihovim japanskim kolegama. Murali su unosni i za velike korporacije. programme.title: Legends of Paris romanticism / Legende Pariškog romantizma
programme.desc: Larmee des Romantiques - (E03, Art Program, France, 2024) The French Revolution of February 1848 overthrew the monarchy and brought poets to power. Lamartine proclaims the Republic. The Republic of the Republic is also joined by Dumas, Hugo and Sand. But when the new president should be elected, the French people are elected by Louis Napoleon Bonaparte. Elected to the National Assembly in the ranks of the conservative side, Hugo still feels that his beliefs were shaken. The writer simply cannot close his eyes to the misery that surrounds him. One young painter comes to the center of attention by painting ordinary people - Gustave Courbet inventing realism. Balzac dies behind, leaving a colossal oeuvre that has exhausted every drop of his energy. Louis Napoleon is declared an emperor, which encourages Hugoa to definitely turn to the left in political terms. The writer has no choice but to escape from France. Dumas is also forced to leave for personal bankruptcy. The two of them, therefore, will not be able to say goodbye to their friend Nerval at the funeral. Lamartine proglašava Republiku. Projektu Republike pridružuju se i Dumas, Hugo i Sand. No kad treba izabrati novog predsjednika, francuski narod bira Luja Napoleona Bonapartea. Izabran u Narodnu skupštinu u redovima konzervativne strane, Hugo ipak osjeća kako su mu uvjerenja poljuljana. Književnik naprosto ne može zatvoriti oči pred bijedom koja ga okružuje. Jedan mladi slikar dolazi u središte pozornosti slikajući obične ljude - Gustave Courbet izmišlja realizam. Balzac umire za sobom ostavljajući kolosalan opus koji je iscrpio svaku kap njegove energije. Luj Napoleon proglašava se carem, što Hugoa potiče da u političkom smislu definitivno skrene ulijevo. Pisac nema drugog izbora nego pobjeći iz Francuske. Dumas je također prisiljen otići zbog osobnog bankrota. Njih se dvojica stoga neće moći na sprovodu oprostiti od svog prijatelja Nervala. programme.title: Holy mountains of the world / Svete planine svijeta
programme.desc: Holy Mountains of the World - (E04, Traveling Series, Croatia, 2005) A thousand kilometers away from civilization, in the middle of the Tibetic desolate plateau, as a mountain crystal stands a lonely pyramid of rocks and ice. Kailash. What for the old Greeks was Olympus or for Christians St. Mountain on Sinai, this is still this mountain for Hindu, Buddhist and followers of Bon, the pre -banking religion in Tibet. For Hindu, this mountain is the throne of the Almighty God of Shiva, and for Buddhists a huge natural mandala or a wheel of life. For both religions it is the origin of the Tantric forces and the center of the universe. In the shadow of this holy mountain, at an altitude of 4500 meters, Lake Mansarowar lies from Brahma's thoughts. Even for unbelievers, mountains and lake are rare gems of magical beauty, clean light and expressed colors. The HTV team, author of the Stipe Bozic series and cameraman Josko Bojic, follow the pilgrimage around Kailas, which the Tibetans call the bark, lasts from 3 to 5 days and everyone is looking forward to him, most of them children. Most Indians prefer to ride on Jacobs, although it can be more dangerous than walking itself. For some of the Tibetan pilgrims, the bark is a prostration, all the way around Kailash. Through which is 50 kilometers long and climbs to an altitude of 5700 meters. The most difficult part of the pilgrimage is over 5700 meters high saddle Drows La. Here many Indian pilgrims, unaccustomed to diluted air, give up because of a height disease. Each year, 6 pilgrims die on an average of an average. R.: Stipe Christmas ... / Svete planine svijeta - (E04, putopisna serija, Hrvatska, 2005) Tisuću kilometra daleko od civilizacije, usred Tibetske puste visoravni, kao gorski kristal stoji osamljena piramida od stijena i leda. Kailash. Ono što je za stare Grke bio Olimp ili za kršćane Sveta gora na Sinaju, to je još uvijek ova planina za hinduiste, budiste i sljedbenike Bona, predbudističke religije u Tibetu. Za hinduiste ova je planina prijestolje svemoćnog boga Šive, a za budiste golema prirodna mandala ili kotač života. Za obje religije to je ishodište tantričkih sila i središte svemira. U sjeni ove svete planine, na nadmorskoj visini od 4500 metara, leži jezero Mansarowar, rođeno iz Brahminih misli. Čak i za nevjernike, planina i jezero rijetki su dragulji magične ljepote, čistoga svjetla i izraženih boja. Ekipa HTV-a, autor serije Stipe Božić i snimatelj Joško Bojić, prate hodočašće oko Kailasa, koje Tibetanci zovu kora, traje od 3 do 5 dana i svi mu se vesele, a najviše djeca. Većina Indijaca radije jaše na jakovima, iako to može biti opasnije od samog hodanja. Za neke od tibetanskih hodočasnika kora je prostracija, i to cijelim putem oko Kailasha. Putem koji je dug 50 kilometara, a penje se do nadmorske visine od 5700 metara. Najteži dio hodočašća prelazak je preko 5700 metara visokog sedla Drolma La. Tu mnogi indijski hodočasnici, nenavikli na razrijeđeni zrak, odustanu zbog visinske bolesti. Svake godine na kori u prosjeku umre 6 hodočasnika. R.: Stipe Božić...

Čak i za nevjernike, planina i jezero rijetki su dragulji magične ljepote, čistoga svjetla i izraženih boja. programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2018) There are a lot of great musicians in Croatia playing on various occasions in a wide variety of combinations. But how does a really good jazz surgery come about? As a composition without a harmonic instrument, piano or guitar, it seems to be easily released by stereotypes. They adapt to the place where they play and to the audience, which goes to these places, adapt to each other, play their own and others, but every time differently. In doing so, they rely not only on our own experience and talent, but also to what we can call musical intelligence. Enough of the most profitable lovers are no longer considered a promising band, but a band that pretends to a leading place on the Croatian jazz bridge. As a tireless music philosopher, Kruno Levacic always raises a essential question about how to play in a band that is not boring. Maybe he finally found the answer in trouble. R.: Melanija Povic Jagarinec ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2018) U Hrvatskoj ima puno sjajnih muzičara koji sviraju u raznim prigodama u najrazličitijim kombinacijama. Kao sastav bez harmonijskog instrumenta, klavira ili gitare, čini se da se lako oslobađaju stereotipova. Prilagođavaju se mjestu gdje sviraju i publici koja na ta mjesta zalazi, prilagođavaju se jedni drugima, sviraju svoje i tuđe, ali svaki puta drugačije. Pri tome se oslanjaju ne samo na vlastito iskustvo i talent, nego i na ono što bismo mogli nazvati glazbenom inteligencijom. Dovoljno da ih se u krugovima najprofinjenijih ljubitelja više ne smatra perspektivnim bendom, nego bendom koji pretendira na vodeće mjesto na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni. Kao neumoran glazbeni filozof, Kruno Levačić uvijek i iznova postavlja suštinsko pitanje o tome kako svirati u bendu koji nije dosadan. Možda je upravo u Problemima konačno pronašao odgovor. programme.desc: Larmee des Romantiques - (E04, Artistic Program, France, 2024) in the exile on the island of Guernsey Hugo again reveals a passion for large novels. With the help of Juliette Drouet, he finishes "poor people" while the young generation of artists in Paris is fighting for his place. "Mrs. Bovary", "Flowers of Evil", "Breakfast on the Grass" - all these works of art is cenzured. Delacroix dies, leaving Baudelaire in art as an orphan. The poet feels like he no longer belongs to the new, glittering Paris created by Georges-Eugène Haussmann. Allergic to modernization, he retreats into the exile to Belgium, returning to France just before death. Nadar raises the photo to the level of a new artistic form, drawing inspiration from the first futuristic novels of Jules Verne. But the war soon brings to the end of the rule of Napoleon III. Hugo returns to France as a hero. Together with Sand, Gautier and Dumas, he finally testifies to the triumph of freedom and the Republic. "Gospođa Bovary", "Cvjetovi zla", "Doručak na travi" - sva su ta umjetnička djela cenzurirana. Delacroix umire, ostavljajući Baudelairea u umjetničkom smislu kao siroče. Pjesnik se osjeća kao da više ne pripada novom, blještavom Parizu koji je stvorio Georges-Eugène Haussmann. Alergičan na modernizaciju, povlači se u izgnanstvo u Belgiju, vraćajući se u Francusku tek pred smrt. Nadar fotografiju podiže na razinu nove umjetničke forme, crpeći nadahnuće iz prvih futurističkih romana Julesa Vernea. No rat ubrzo donosi kraj vladavini Napoleona III. Hugo se u Francusku vraća kao heroj. Zajedno sa Sand, Gautierom i Dumasom, napokon svjedoči trijumfu slobode i Republike. R.: Amelie Harrault Ul.: Cecile de France (la narratrice)...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2018) There are a lot of great musicians in Croatia playing on various occasions in a wide variety of combinations. But how does a really good jazz surgery come about? Zagreb drummer Kruno Levacic after who knows how much permutation and change he has formed with three young musicians - Ivar Roban Križić, Luka Žužić and Marija Bočić - Quartet Problems. As a composition without a harmonic instrument, piano or guitar, it seems to be easily released by stereotypes. They adapt to the place where they play and to the audience, which goes to these places, adapt to each other, play their own and others, but every time differently. In doing so, they rely not only on our own experience and talent, but also to what we can call musical intelligence. Enough of the most profitable lovers are no longer considered a promising band, but a band that pretends to a leading place on the Croatian jazz bridge. As a tireless music philosopher, Kruno Levacic always raises a essential question about how to play in a band that is not boring. Maybe he finally found the answer in trouble. R.: Melanija Povic Jagarinec ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2018) U Hrvatskoj ima puno sjajnih muzičara koji sviraju u raznim prigodama u najrazličitijim kombinacijama. No, kako nastaje zaista dobar jazz-sastav? Zagrebački bubnjar Kruno Levačić nakon tko zna koliko permutacija i izmjena oformio je s trojicom mladih glazbenika - Ivarom Robanom Križićem, Lukom Žužićem i Marijem Bočićem - kvartet Problemi. Kao sastav bez harmonijskog instrumenta, klavira ili gitare, čini se da se lako oslobađaju stereotipova. Prilagođavaju se mjestu gdje sviraju i publici koja na ta mjesta zalazi, prilagođavaju se jedni drugima, sviraju svoje i tuđe, ali svaki puta drugačije. Pri tome se oslanjaju ne samo na vlastito iskustvo i talent, nego i na ono što bismo mogli nazvati glazbenom inteligencijom. Dovoljno da ih se u krugovima najprofinjenijih ljubitelja više ne smatra perspektivnim bendom, nego bendom koji pretendira na vodeće mjesto na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni. Kao neumoran glazbeni filozof, Kruno Levačić uvijek i iznova postavlja suštinsko pitanje o tome kako svirati u bendu koji nije dosadan. Možda je upravo u Problemima konačno pronašao odgovor. R.: Melanija Pović Jagarinec...

programme.title: My way / Moj put
programme.desc: My journey - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2025) This week's path took us to about four hours of drive from Zagreb's remote capital of Austria Vienna. His history begins more than 4 millennia ago, making Vienna one of the older metropolis in the heart of Europe. But let's go back to the present and story that the "beautiful blue Danube" is experienced by its inhabitants. They themselves are proof of multiculturalism and multinationality to many immigrants always attractive places to life and business development. Karasev Croatian Christian, Andrea from Vares in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Iranac Hessamedin, Burgenland Croatian Viktoria and a Saroly Society of Zagreb Architects with Vienna address have shared with us their emigrant experiences in a city that gives a lot, but also in return. R .: Silvija Trnčević ... / Moj put - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Ovotjedni Moj put odveo nas je do oko četiri sata vožnje od Zagreba udaljenog glavnoga grada Austrije Beča. Njegova povijest počinje prije više od 4 tisućljeća, što Beč čini jednom od starijih metropola u srcu Europe. No vratimo se u sadašnjost i priču kako metropolu uz "lijepi plavi Dunav" doživljavaju njegovi stanovnici. I oni sami dokaz su multikulturalnosti i multinacionalnosti mnogim doseljenicima oduvijek privlačnog mjesta za život i poslovni razvoj. Karaševska Hrvatica Christiana, Andrea iz Vareša u Bosni i Hercegovini, Iranac Hessamedin, gradišćanska Hrvatica Viktoria i šaroliko društvo zagrebačkih arhitekata s bečkom adresom podijelili su s nama svoja iseljenička iskustva u gradu koji puno daje, ali i traži zauzvrat. R.: Silvija Trnčević...

programme.desc: Studio 4: Diagnosis - (Show Magazine, Croatia, 2025) often highlights the problem of obesity and its impact on health. In the show, we will talk about the risks of overweight relating to characteristic neurological diseases. These are stroke, hypertension, sleep disorders and obstructive apnea, mental and neurocognitive disorders ... The guest diagnosis is academician Vanja Bašić Kes, Head of the Clinic of the Neurology of KBC Sisters of Mercy. See the show through the hrti multimedia platform, whose video library is aired editions ... / Studio 4: Dijagnoza - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Često se ističe problem debljine i njezin utjecaj na zdravlje. U emisiji ćemo govoriti o rizicima prekomjerne težine koji se odnose na karakteristične neurološke bolesti. To su moždani udar, hipertenzija, poremećaji spavanja i opstruktivna apneja, psihički i neurokognitivni poremećaji... Gošća Dijagnoze je akademkinja Vanja Bašić Kes, predstojnica Klinike za neurologiju KBC Sestre milosrdnice. Emisiju pogledajte i preko multimedijske platforme HRTi, u čijoj se videoteci nalaze emitirana izdanja...

programme.title: My way / Moj put
programme.desc: My journey - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2025) This week's path took us to about four hours of drive from Zagreb's remote capital of Austria Vienna. His history begins more than 4 millennia ago, making Vienna one of the older metropolis in the heart of Europe. But let's go back to the present and story that the "beautiful blue Danube" is experienced by its inhabitants. They themselves are proof of multiculturalism and multinationality to many immigrants always attractive places to life and business development. Karasev Croatian Christian, Andrea from Vares in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Iranac Hessamedin, Burgenland Croatian Viktoria and a Saroly Society of Zagreb Architects with Vienna address have shared with us their emigrant experiences in a city that gives a lot, but also in return. R .: Silvija Trnčević ... / Moj put - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Ovotjedni Moj put odveo nas je do oko četiri sata vožnje od Zagreba udaljenog glavnoga grada Austrije Beča. Njegova povijest počinje prije više od 4 tisućljeća, što Beč čini jednom od starijih metropola u srcu Europe. No vratimo se u sadašnjost i priču kako metropolu uz "lijepi plavi Dunav" doživljavaju njegovi stanovnici. I oni sami dokaz su multikulturalnosti i multinacionalnosti mnogim doseljenicima oduvijek privlačnog mjesta za život i poslovni razvoj. Karaševska Hrvatica Christiana, Andrea iz Vareša u Bosni i Hercegovini, Iranac Hessamedin, gradišćanska Hrvatica Viktoria i šaroliko društvo zagrebačkih arhitekata s bečkom adresom podijelili su s nama svoja iseljenička iskustva u gradu koji puno daje, ali i traži zauzvrat. R.: Silvija Trnčević...

programme.title: Romano Bolkovic - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Romano Bolkovic - 1 to 1 - (Talk Show, Croatia, 2025) with guest Nenad Bakic we will discuss the public concentration on Trump as a person, not the political processes he triggers on, the reasons and effects of the abolition of USAID and Harangi against Elon Musk, the fears of the oligarchy, the male and its influence, on the position of Europe, On the demographic projections of Croatia, the abolition of the fact-checking, the results of the robotic league and the stem of literacy, the AI ​​revolution, about why the problem is in education, and not so much in curriculum, about the pollution problem, how much Croats care about their health, what we should do with excess money, the boycott of stores, and the Pandemia. Nenad Bakic, entrepreneur and investor, mathematician by education, until his thirties, worked at the Mathematical Faculty in Zagreb, when he went to the world of entrepreneurship. Deals first of all finances, it is the first in Croatia to receive the prestigious Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) title. He is best known as the MojPosao portal, who once transformed employment in Croatia. Founded other companies to which he still owns. As an investor, he promoted investment in shares of Croatian tourist companies. Jury member for the EY Entrepreneur of the Year. Together with his wife, the founder and financier of the Institute for Youth Development and Innovation, whose STEM program is Croatian Makers is the largest unrestrained educational program in the European Union. He was also a leading pandemic analyst in Croatia and the author of Mrcmo epidemic model, the only one in Croatia, and thanks to his pandemic engagement, Croatia avoided rigid measures of a multitude of countries. In its analyzes, the economy, demographics, health and other important topics are touched on ... / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1 - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2025) S gostom Nenadom Bakićem razgovarat ćemo o koncentriranju javnosti na Trumpa kao osobu, a ne političke procese koje pokreće, o razlozima i učincima ukidanja USAID-a i harangi protiv Elona Muska, o bojazni od oligarhije, Muska i njegova utjecaja, o položaju Europe i današnjoj europskoj AI industriji, o budućnosti električnih automobila, o demografskim projekcijama Hrvatske, o ukidanju fact-checkinga, o rezultatima robotičke lige i STEM opismenjavanja, o AI revoluciji, o tome zašto je problem u školstvu, a ne toliko u kurikulumu, o problemu onečišćenja, o tome koliko se Hrvati brinu o svom zdravlju, o tome što bismo trebali raditi s viškom novca, o bojkotu trgovina, te o rezimeu pandemije. Nenad Bakić, poduzetnik i ulagač, matematičar po obrazovanju, do svoje tridesete radio je na Matematičkom fakultetu u Zagrebu, kada se otisnuo u svijet poduzetništva. Baveći se ponajprije financijama, prvi je u Hrvatskoj koji je dobio prestižnu titulu Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA). Najpoznatiji je po portalu MojPosao, koji je svojedobno transformirao zapošljavanje u Hrvatskoj. Osnovao i druge kompanije kojima je i dalje vlasnik. Kao ulagač promovirao je ulaganje u dionice hrvatskih turističkih kompanija. Član žirija za EY poduzetnik godine. Zajedno sa suprugom osnivač je i financijer Instituta za razvoj i inovativnost mladih, čiji je STEM program Croatian Makers najveći nedržavni obrazovni program u Europskoj uniji. Također, bio je vodeći analitičar pandemije u Hrvatskoj te autor MRCMO epidemijskog modela, jedinog u Hrvatskoj, te je zahvaljujući njegovu angažmanu za pandemije Hrvatska izbjegla rigidne mjere mnoštva država. U svojim analizama dotiče se gospodarstva, demografije, zdravlja i drugih važnih tema...

programme.desc: The film revolves around the life of the isolated singer (Brian Wilson), starting from his great artistic success in his beginnings during the 1960s with The Beach Boys to the nervous collapse that afflicted him from following and pursuing the media to his personal life, to his return and appearing recently to the artistic scene as one of the songwriters and singers who are known for their efficiency and talent. / تدور أحداث الفيلم حول حياة المغني المنعزل (براين ويلسون)، ابتداءًا من نجاحه الفني الكبير في بداياته خلال حقبة الستينيات مع فرقة ذا بيتش بويز إلى الانهيار العصبي الذي أصابه من متابعة وملاحقة الإعلام لحياته الشخصية، إلى عودته وظهوره مؤخرًا إلى الساحة الفنية بوصفه من كاتبي الأغاني والمطربين المشهود لهم بالكفاءة والموهبة الفائقة.

programme.desc: A famous singer and her diligent help trying to search for a way to pass a difficult choice that brings them to them on the horizon, a choice that could change the course of their working life forever. / تحاول مغنية مشهورة ومساعدتها المجتهدة البحث عن وسيلة لاجتياز اختيار صعب يلوج أمامهما في اﻷفق، وهو الاختيار الذي من الممكن أن يغير مسار حياتهما العملية للأبد.

programme.desc: A story about the volatile relationship between the teacher and his student, Trans Fletcher (GK Simans) is a distinguished jazz musician, and he is the teacher of the ambitious drums Andrew Niman (Miles Tiller), although the (Trans) educational style is very severe, and violent to the maximum, but he wants to reach perfection and idealism, even if the price is to harsh on his students, so what is the destiny that the player can bear Undertaker (Andrew) for excellence in his work? / قصة حول العلاقة المتقلبة بين المُعلم وتلميذه ، ترانس فليتشر (جي كيه سيمونز) موسيقار جاز متميز ، وهو المُعلم الخاص بقارع الطبول الطموح أندرو نيمان (مايلز تيلر) ، برغم أن أسلوب (ترانس) التعليمي قاس جدًا ، وعنيف لأقصى حد إلا أنه يريد الوصول للكمال والمثالية ، حتى لو كان الثمن هو أن يقسو على طلابه ، فما القَدْر الذي يمكن أن يتحمله العازف الطموح (أندرو) من أجل التميز في عمله؟

سامح،وجاء شكرى(احمدفتحى)صديق سامح ومعه فرشة الحشيش لزوم الفرح وجلس يلف السجائر، وجاء مدير الامن (سامى مغاورى) لمجاملة أكثم وجلس بجوار شكرى وكاد ان يكشفه، واتصلت بوسى بسامح على انها فتاة تريد لقاءه محشوة شربها فى الحمام وكشفه مدير الامن، وقبض عليه أكثم واراد حبسه ،لولا شفاعة مدير الامن، وصعد يحيى لحجرته لإحضار الشبكة، وفوجئ بوجود بوسى ورأتهم مى (الهام عبدالبديع) صديقة مها فأخبرتها، ولكن يحيى programme.title: Woh toh hai albelaa / Woh Toh Hai Albelaa
programme.desc: (Krishna) is a fun brother who loves his brother and always stands beside them, especially his older brother (Chero), who is doing his best to maintain his safety and protect him from any harm, then his life turns upside down when circumstances force him to marry Habiba (Chero). / (كريشنا) هو أخ مرح محب لشقيقيه ويقف بجانبهما دائمًا، وبالأخص شقيقه الأكبر (تشيرو) الذي يبذل قصارى جهده للحفاظ على سلامته وحمايته من أي مكروه، ثم تنقلب حياته رأسًا على عقب عندما تجبره الظروف على الزواج من حبيبة (تشيرو).

programme.title: My mom / أمي
programme.desc: Basma lives in a house that is shrouded in violence and neglect because of her mother's husband, Obaid, who suffers from a smile of ill -treatment and lack of safety, which makes her life full of fear and loneliness. Her teacher, Maryam, hinted silent signs of Basma's suffering, so she decided to intervene to save her from this difficult situation.
